_meta.description: 16-qubit wormhole-analog noisy native-gate simulations from constructed circuits. Entropy index 0=boundary, 1=bulk. Uses optimized encoding and optimized recovery for magic-injected experiments when enabled. This file may contain only a subset of magic values.
_meta.qst_note: QST entropy runs are repeated finite-shot tomography experiments. Trajectory batching uses K noisy circuit trajectories per Pauli basis, with shots split across trajectories. The saved noisy_QST/std and noisy_QST/qes_std preserve the simulator's final uncertainty mode.
